fields.Name: T110 - Home App Cards and Recent Items
fields.Description: Verifies that the application cards and Recent Items section render on the Home landing page, and that clicking an application card navigates into that app.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to the Home app landing page (route /app/home) - use the Home icon/logo or the application switcher dropdown next to the logo if needed (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). On the Home landing page, confirm the application cards (for the available apps such as Data Explorer, AI, Admin) and the Recent Items section render. Then click one of the application cards. The success state is that the app card click navigates into that application (the app's section loads, e.g. /app/data-explorer or /app/ai). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for each page to finish loading, do not navigate away early.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Home landing page showed application cards for the available apps and a Recent Items section (populated or a valid empty-state)
After clicking an application card, the view navigated into that application and its section content is rendered
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
